text:
Max Sasson is one of the fastest skaters in the league. EDGE puts his top speed in the 94th percentile and his count of 20 mph bursts in the 98th, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 57% of his entries last season, a rare habit for a depth forward. Carry-ins lead to chances far more often than dump-ins.

He has six goals in 23 games on about 12 minutes a night, which is more than his chances explain. He has 2.8 expected goals (the quality of his looks) and is shooting 24%, after 21% last season, so the finishing is a habit, just not one that usually holds at this level. Our numbers flag him as due to cool.

The odd part runs the other way. The Canucks have scored 13.0 fewer goals than their chances deserved with him on the ice, and his relative 5v5 shot share is strong. That has cost him assists. His ice time has slipped over his last ten games to 11:27, so the question is whether Vancouver keeps finding minutes for the legs.
